signIn.description: Default true. false when the app keeps secrets in expo-secure-store (an API key, a database key) but nobody signs in: check-auth then runs the storage rules only and asks for none of the sign-in facts.

sessionFactory.description: The function that creates the session; the file that calls it must pass every sign-out step. Default createSessionManager.

protectedGroups.description: Route groups only a signed-in person may open, e.g. "(app)": each must sit inside a <Stack.Protected> (or Tabs/Drawer).

signedOutRoutes.description: Routes only a signed-out person sees, e.g. "sign-in": each must sit inside a .Protected element too.

signOutSteps.description: Names of the sign-out steps besides the token wipe (query-cache, account-store, ...). A step x-y is written { name: 'x-y' } or made by xYStep(...).

serverSignOutSteps.description: Names of the server steps that run before the wipe on signOut('user'), with the still-valid access token, under one deadline (push-registration, server-session).

createsAccounts.description: true when people can create an account in the app: App Store guideline 5.1.1(v) and Google Play then require deleting it from inside the app.

accountDeletionRoute.description: The repo path of the route file that starts account deletion (required when createsAccounts is true).

oauthSharedBrowserSession.description: null (the default: an ephemeral browser session), or the reason the app shares the system browser's cookies with the provider.

customAndroidBackupRules.description: null (the default: the expo-secure-store config plugin writes Android's backup rules), or the path of the app's own rules that exclude the SecureStore shared preferences.
